# Format: METHOD full-path-template. Parameter names are compared as
# wildcards: {slug} and :slug match any parameter in that position.

GET /api/user

GET /api/profiles/{username}
POST /api/profiles/{username}/follow
DELETE /api/profiles/{username}/follow
